cameraMotionSOP: Shot 1: Slow handheld push forward with slight sway, occasional static glitch frames.
Shot 2: Very slow zoom toward the glowing eyes, hold with dread, sudden cut to black.
Shot 3: Static overlay intensifies, tracking lines roll, camera shake on text reveal.
Shot 4: Slow pan across the mine, then reverse dolly retreat feeling of being watched.

scriptBlueprint.hookArchetype: Mở màn bằng băng ghi hình 1979 cũ kỹ + tiếng nói hồi tưởng (Found-Footage Analog Horror Hook)
scriptBlueprint.openingFormula: Mở bằng đoạn băng VHS nhiễu static kèm thoại hồi tưởng: 'predictions... who do you guys think's gonna win... I think Holes kind of got him... they both really intense...' — tạo cảm giác tài liệu thực được khai quật, khán giả đứng từ góc nhìn người trong cuộc.
scriptBlueprint.pacingStructure: [0-15s] Băng VHS nhiễu + thoại mơ hồ -> [15-45s] Giới thiệu bối cảnh CRAFT (1979) + lời cảnh báo -> [45s-hết] Hành trình xuống hầm mỏ: 3-4 tầng leo thang dread (mỗi 90s 1 chi tiết bất ổn) -> [Kết thúc] Đối đầu The Elder mở kết + teaser tập sau
scriptBlueprint.masterScriptPromptShort: Prompt chuẩn giữ 70% cốt truyện analog horror gốc + 30% lore ẩn mới, chia 3-6 Part (500-800 từ/Part), điều khiển bằng lệnh 'CONTINUE' và dừng bằng 'Stop' theo chuẩn North Effect.
scriptBlueprint.masterScriptPrompt:
You are a professional analog horror scriptwriter specializing in found-footage 1980s retro horror and unsettling Minecraft-style narratives (style of LatentDiffusion CRAFT (1979), The Mandela Catalogue, and Kane Pixels).

I will provide you with [the full original transcript from a competitor's video].
Your task:

1. Rewrite & Restructure:
   - Keep 70% of the original script to preserve the storyline, factual accuracy, and core structure.
   - Add 30% new content: creative expansion, context, expert commentary, or contrasting angles using grounded research.
   - Writing style: Atmospheric, restrained, dread-building, ambiguous dialogue, archival-tape framing, psychological horror. Keep 70% of the original analog horror storyline; add 30% new hidden lore, environmental dread details, and unsettling implications without gore or cheap jumpscares.

2. Technical Requirements:
   - Total length depends on the original video script provided.
   - Divide the script into 3-6 parts (for a 7-20 minute analog horror short).
   - Each part should be 500-800 words, written in continuous narrative with [Action Notes] for the voxel animator, written in continuous narrative (no subheadings inside, ready for voiceover).
   - Title each part as: Part n (n = sequence number).

3. Workflow Instructions:
   - For every command "CONTINUE" from me:
     - You must expand only the next part according to the sequence.
     - Do not skip ahead.
   - At the end of each part, write "Stop" so I can issue the "CONTINUE" command.
   - After the final part is completed, you must add "Script Completed" at the very end.

---
📌 How to Use:
- Step 1: I will paste the competitor's full transcript after this prompt.
- Step 2: You will start rewriting Part 1 according to the rules above.
- Step 3: I will type "CONTINUE" to move forward part by part until the entire script is finished.

* Competitor's Reference Video: CRAFT (1979): The First Night | Episode 1 (zX-e9LRR_ko - 2.17M views)
* Here is the competitor's transcript:
[PASTE TRANSCRIPT FROM THE BUTTON '📜 Kịch Bản Gốc' HERE]
